relationships.evidence_quote: At V12, MMDs were reduced by 6.0 days in HFEM and by 11.9 days in CM patients (both p < 0.00001)

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: mAbs targeting the CGRP ligand (i.e., galcanezumab [3, 4, 5], fremanezumab [6, 7], and eptinezumab [8])

relationships.subject: higher BMI
relationships.evidence_quote: Persistent responders were less likely to have a higher body mass index (BMI) (p = 0.007)

key_findings: In 191 real-life patients galcanezumab reduced MMDs over 12 months; 56.5% were persistent responders.
Good triptan response, lower BMI and early 50% response predicted persistent response.
